title: Demystifying On-Policy Distillation: Where Does the Teacher's Advantage Live?
abstract: arXiv:2610.19145v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly studied as a cheaper alternative to reinforcement learning, yet it remains a form of knowledge distillation (KD) that relies on teacher supervision. We revisit OPD from the KD perspective by asking where the teacher's advantage lies along student-generated trajectories. Controlled token flips at teacher-student disagreements directly measure the accuracy gained from teacher corrections. Single-token flips yield a modest average gain on selected failed trajectories, whereas repeated flips raise accuracy from 28.4% to 74.5%, close to the teacher's 76.9%. Gains continue to accumulate with more flips, but mass- and KL-based selection outperform random flips by 15-18 percentage points at counts of similar magnitude. Selective intervention remains useful after OPD, but greater argmax agreement does not consistently improve accuracy across model pairs. We advocate training schedules that learn more v

translated_title: 揭秘在线策略蒸馏：教师模型的优势究竟在哪里？
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏日益被视为一种比强化学习更廉价的替代方案，但它本质上仍是一种依赖教师监督的知识蒸馏（KD）形式。我们从知识蒸馏的视角重新审视在线策略蒸馏，探究教师模型的优势在学生模型生成的轨迹中究竟体现在何处。通过在师生不一致的位置进行受控的token翻转，可以直接衡量教师纠正所带来的准确率提升。在筛选出的失败轨迹上，单次token翻转仅带来适度的平均收益，而重复翻转可将准确率从28.4%提升至74.5%，接近教师模型的76.9%。收益随翻转次数增加而持续累积，但在相似数量级下，基于概率质量和KL散度的选择方法比随机翻转高出15-18个百分点。在线策略蒸馏之后，选择性干预仍然有用，但更大程度的argmax一致性并不能在各模型对之间稳定地提升准确率。我们提倡采用能够学习更多（原文在此处截断）的训练计划。
tldr: 该研究通过在师生不一致位置进行受控token翻转的干预实验，量化了在线策略蒸馏中教师优势的来源，发现重复的选择性纠正可将学生准确率从28.4%提升至74.5%（接近教师的76.9%），且基于概率质量和KL散度的选择性干预比随机翻转高出15-18个百分点。
en_tdlr: This study quantifies where the teacher's advantage lives in on-policy distillation through controlled token flips at teacher-student disagreements, showing that repeated selective corrections raise student accuracy from 28.4% to 74.5% (close to the teacher's 76.9%), and that mass- and KL-based selective interventions outperform random flips by 15-18 percentage points.
